description: Curated bottle notes + cigarHint (original copy; not transcript paste).

notes.hr: DON JULIO REPOSADO — reposado. Profil drži biljno, citrus i karamela uz srednje tijelo. Neat ili rocks; uz cigaru tempo neka bude sporiji nego uz gin.
notes.en: DON JULIO REPOSADO — reposado. The profile holds biljno, citrus i karamela with medium body. Neat or rocks; beside a cigar keep a slower pace than with gin.

cigarHint.hr: Agava još vodi riječ, ali hrast i vanilija već nose srednju Habano cigaru; drugi dim dolazi mekše nego uz čist blanco.
cigarHint.en: Agave still leads, but oak and vanilla already carry a medium Habano; the second puff arrives softer than with a straight blanco.
